independentLayers.description: How ui-input and ui-select merge ids from a wrapping field with their own label and description ids.

intent: Name one control with a visible label
Show a control's unit and current value beside it in a property row

properties.description: Visible label text; it names the control (aria-labelledby or the control's labelledby). Empty: no label part and no name from the field.
Unit at the label's end (px, ms, %). Part of the accessible name: "Unit px".
Readout text in the readout column. It does not set the control; the application keeps it in step. A slot="readout" child replaces it.
Help text under the control, added to the control's aria-describedby (after a ui-input or ui-select description of its own).

Error message under the control, after the description (Base UI Field.Error), added to the control's aria-describedby. The field does not validate: the application sets it (an invalid kit control also shows its own error). The error part exists only once set.
stacked: label above the control. inline: label beside it (label | control | readout); in a ui-field-grid the columns are shared.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

sources: label (given to the control, not the field)

content.children: One control (ui-range, ui-select, ui-segmented, ui-input, ui-switch, ui-checkbox, ui-button, …) without a label of its own; an optional slot="readout" child. Children stay where they are authored; the field adds its label, readout, description and error parts as siblings, or keeps authored [data-part] ones (composition).

constraints: The control is the first element child that is not a field part or slot="readout". A ui-* control or an element with a role gets aria-labelledby (and aria-describedby) on its host; ui-input and ui-select get their labelledby / describedby properties, which they forward to the editor or trigger. A plain wrapper (a div of several controls) is not labelled: each control inside lists the field's label id (labelIds) in its own labelledby or aria-labelledby.
Do not also give the control its own label: on ui-input and ui-select the own label wins over the field's; on host-role controls aria-labelledby wins over aria-label.
Contains no native form elements and is not form-associated: the control submits its own value.
A press on the label toggles a checkbox, switch or radio control and focuses any other control.
The readout is text the application updates; it is not a live region (a slider already announces its value).
Ids follow the host id when it has one (id="pad" gives pad-field-label, pad-field-unit, pad-field-desc).

Composition: the label (plain text, or contents and suffix spans), readout, description and error may be authored as [data-part] children; their text seeds label, unit, readout, description and error at the first connect, and the field keeps and fills those parts. React: Field.Root with Field.Label (unit prop), Field.Control (no element: it hands the ids to its child, render element or function), Field.Readout, Field.Description and Field.Error as direct children; the Root wires the control from the Label, Description and Error it finds; every React part takes render (an element or (props, state) => element) and className (a string or (state) => string); the recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.

avoidWhen.when: A ui-input or ui-select in a form, with the label above.
avoidWhen.reason: Their own label, description and error already form a field; a wrapper adds nothing.

avoidWhen.when: A checkbox, radio or switch whose text says what it does.
avoidWhen.reason: Choices carry their label as children, next to the indicator.

avoidWhen.when: Several controls under one caption (two selects, a set of fields).
avoidWhen.reason: A field names one control; a fieldset names a set of them with its legend (a set of radios or checkboxes is one choice group, which a field can name).

intent: Align the labels, controls and readouts of a column of inline fields

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

content.children: ui-field rows (layout="inline") and group headings (h1–h6 or role=heading); any other child spans every column.

constraints: Columns: label (content-sized up to 40% of the grid; longer labels truncate), control (fills), readout (the widest readout, at least 10u). Each ui-field child spans them as a subgrid, so every label column and readout column lines up.
Adds no role: wrap it in a section or give headings ids when the groups should be landmarks or named groups.
Headings get the group kicker type role and 4u of space above (none on the first).

avoidWhen.when: A form whose fields stack their labels above the controls.
avoidWhen.reason: Stacked fields share no columns; a container spaces them.

nodes.summary: The label text (the contents of the construction pattern); its id is first in the control's aria-labelledby. Truncates with an ellipsis when the label column is narrow.
The unit suffix at the label's end (fg.subtle, never truncated); its id follows the text in aria-labelledby. Hidden without a unit.

Readout column: tabular figures in the numeric voice, fg.muted, end-aligned, at least 10u wide. From the readout attribute or a slot="readout" child; hidden when empty, and the control then takes its column.
